description: This file defines the UserProfileForm class, which extends AbstractFormProcessor to handle user profile form creation, validation constraints, and saving logic within the Goteo project. It includes methods for generating form fields related to user information such as name, location, social links, interests, and avatar, as well as processing and saving the submitted data.

classes.name: UserProfileForm
classes.description: A form handler class for managing user profile data, including form creation, validation, and persistence within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints for specific form fields, including required fields and social media validation.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Provides default values for the user profile form, excluding test interests and images.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds the user profile form with various fields such as name, location, avatar, social links, interests, and other personal data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission, validates data, handles file uploads, updates user interests, social links, location, and saves changes to the database.
